name: month_successor
description: Produce the month following a named month; matched control copies a marker from the same record.
generator_code:
import random,json,calendar,string
random.seed(0)
months=list(calendar.month_name)[1:]; items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 j=i%12;m=months[j];mark=random.choice(string.ascii_uppercase); text=f'Month: {m}. Marker: {mark}.\n'
 items.append({'prompt':text+'The next month is','answer':' '+months[(j+1)%12]})
 control.append({'prompt':text+'The marker is','answer':' '+mark})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
